route_audit.decision: Direct 4D SO(10) representation-count escape with a falsifiable rank certificate; it replaces, rather than repairs, the V55 filter.
Direct SO(10) component-parity escape with a falsifiable zero-mode certificate; it changes the theory from a finite 4D action to a 6D EFT.

The primary construction is an SU(5)' x SU(5)'' locality/link mechanism, not a supplied one-action SO(10) completion. It remains a possible discretization of R2, but selecting it would add unverified link-vacuum, anomaly, and flavor choices.

An additive selector cannot evade V55 at fixed topology. Moreover, the 4D simple-group, finite-field, exact-MSSM, unbroken-R route lies inside a published no-go theorem. Broken R symmetry, non-Abelian multiplet selection, product groups, and extra dimensions are outside that theorem, but no complete alternative action was verified here.

Integrating out heavy fields is not by itself a selection rule: the full mediator graph must change the V55 incidence relations and must not regenerate the fatal operators. Mediators are retained as an obligation inside a selected blueprint, not as a third blueprint.
